snippet.title: Talk Football HD
snippet.description:
Our Story
Started off watching football as an aficionado.

But there was something that remained stuck inside. “How can you feel so many emotions in an hour and a half!” It had to be something else. Playing football for about a decade made life easier. And then this thought came, “What if we build a community where we can play, talk and breathe football?”

The failure to be a professional football took its toll as I went deeper into the game. Thus came Talk Football HD, a platform that led us to connect with similar people from all around the world. We built on it to analyze day-to-day matches and communicate in the language of football!

Meet our Team -

1. Zeeshan Khan - Host and Content Head
2. Abhishek Gupta - Business and Collaboration Head
3. Shamikh Ansari - Direction and Production Head
4. Ramsha Khan - Social Media and Graphic Head

Feel free to contact us at talkupfootball@gmail.com

Peace out! ✌️
